svg.title: LOC IV flight computer - connected preliminary schematic P2
svg.desc: Two native KiCad sheets: MCU, sensors and telemetry; power, selected battery switch and 1.5A input fuse. Preliminary only, not bench or flight qualified. Zero ERC errors and three reviewed TI-required ST-to-ground type warnings. Existing footprints and PCB unchanged.

g.text: PROTECTION POLICY: protected pack mandatory; F1 supplements PCM.

g.desc: PROTECTION POLICY: protected pack mandatory; F1 supplements PCM.

g.text: No precision current limit; estimated 0.7-1.1 A peaks are unmeasured.

g.text: Target <=1.0 A sustained; qualify pulses, temperature and supply dips.

g.text: SW1 disconnects BATTERY ONLY. Remove both USB cables for power-off.

g.desc: SW1 disconnects BATTERY ONLY. Remove both USB cables for power-off.

g.text: No carrier charging. No flight use or fabrication release from ERC.

g.text: Both VOUT pads connected; unused ST is NC.

g.desc: USB hot-plug and source transitions require bench validation.

g.text: Adafruit PID258 protected 1S LiPo only: 3.7 V nominal / 4.2 V max.

g.desc: Adafruit PID258 protected 1S LiPo only: 3.7 V nominal / 4.2 V max.

g.text: SW1: C&K 7101SYZQE, panel SPDT, 5 A at 28 VDC (resistive).

g.text: Use terminals 2-3 for ON; insulate unused terminal 1.
